newsitem.title: USA: MiniMed files to sell up to 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: MiniMed files to sell up to 2 mln shares.

text.p: MiniMed Inc on Friday filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.
Of the total amount, one million common will be sold by the company and one million common will be sold by selling stockholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 12,843,025 common.
Of the selling shareholders, Alfred Mann, chairman and chief executive, will offer 500,000 common shares for sale, the filing said.
The company offered the underwriters a 30-day overallotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common shares.
The offering will be made through UBS Securities, Dillon Read & Co Inc, Hambrecht & Quist and Smith Barney Inc.

The company will use net proceeds for structural improvements on its primary facility and to purchase manufacturing, information systems and other equipment. Some of the proceeds will be earmarked for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
MiniMed, based in Sylmar, Calif., makes microinfusion systems for delivery of a variety of drugs, with a primary focus on the intensive management of diabetes.
